critical_code_review_comments: PatientHistoryStrip.tsx wasTransferredFromMe check reads procedure.previous_students of the CURRENT case being viewed, not the target locked case — works today because in the seeded scenario the viewer (Gaurav) IS in caseA.previous_students, but if a viewer lands on a case they own outright and there is another locked case in the strip belonging to a different transfer chain, the personalised 'from you' wording could show incorrectly. Consider driving the wording off a per-row backend hint (e.g. case.transferred_from_me boolean) or off the current user's presence in the LOCKED case's previous_students rather than the current case's.

buildLabSlipHtml overlay only fires when procedure.implants[] arrives pre-resolved from GET /procedures/{id}. Any caller that hydrates a procedure via a lighter endpoint (list view / offline cache) could bypass the overlay silently. Adding a defensive client-side resolver or documenting the requirement on the function would prevent future regressions.
